reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses rather than adding new selection logic.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in one SQL clause inside the shared helper; the actions only forward the flag.

placement.why: The change lives in the shared category-selection helper in server/budget/actions.ts, where the existing exclusions are decided.

scope.why: Only the helper signature, its query and the six month-wide action signatures change (plus a type tweak for cat_group).

maintainability.why: A single defaulted boolean parameter is clear; the conditional SQL fragment by string interpolation and the repeated per-action argument plumbing are minor blemishes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep going through getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the flag is threaded into the one shared helper.
